extract: The Undermine, or just Undermine, is the subterranean capital city of the goblins, located in the bowels of Mount Kajaro on the Isle of Kezan in the South Seas. Weaving through the heart of Kezan in a dizzying network of tunnels, vaults, and lava tubes, Undermine epitomizes the goblins' complex, unpredictable mindset. The city has many sluicetowns such as Pyrix, and its air is stale and oily. Troll slaves work in the city. The city of Bilgewater Port, located on the surface of Kezan, linked to the underground metropolis.

{{Race|Hozen}} | language = [[Goblin (language)|Goblin]] | affiliation = [[Trade Coalition]], [[Cartels of Undermine]] ([[Bilgewater Cartel (Undermine)|Bilgewater]], [[Blackwater Cartel (faction)|Blackwater]], [[Steamwheedle Cartel (faction)|Steamwheedle]], [[Venture Company (faction)|Venture Company]]), [[Darkfuse Solutions]], [[Tinkers' Union]] | loc = Beneath [[Kezan]] | status = Active | territory = }} '''The Undermine''', or just '''Undermine''', is the subterranean [[capital]] [[Settlement#City|city]] of the [[goblin]]s, located in the bowels of [[Mount Kajaro]] on the [[Kezan|Isle of Kezan]] in the [[South Seas]]. Weaving through the heart of Kezan in a dizzying network of tunnels, vaults, and lava tubes, Undermine epitomizes the goblins' complex, unpredictable mindset.{{Ref web|url=http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/cataclysm/features/goblin.html|title=World of Warcraft: Cataclysm - Features - Goblins|archiveurl=http://web.archive.org/web/20111213145639/http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/cataclysm/features/goblin.html|archivedate=2011-12-13}}{{Ref web|url=http://us.battle.net/wow/en/game/race/goblin|title=Goblin - Game Guide - World of Warcraft|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130716175718/http://us.battle.net/wow/en/game/race/goblin|archivedate=2013-07-16}} The city has many {{wplink|Placer mining|sluicetowns}} such as [[Pyrix]], and its air is stale and oily.''[[The Blank Scroll]]'', pg. 1 [[Troll]] [[slave]]s work in the city.[[Good Help is Hard to Find]] The city of [[Bilgewater Port]], located on the surface of Kezan, linked to the underground metropolis.''[[World of Warcraft: Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', pg. 153 ==History== ===Background=== The [[Zandalari troll]]s{{Ref WoWCV1|158}} originally enslaved the goblins and forced them to mine [[kaja'mite]] ore from the bowels of [[Mount Kajaro]]. After the goblins' intelligence was heightened by the magical mineral and they revolted against the trolls to claim Kezan for themselves, the mines that had been their prison, their slave camp, and the base of their rebellion now became the city of Undermine.{{Ref web|url=https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/game/races/goblin|title=Goblin - WoW|accessdate=2019-06-03}} It was there that they built the foundations of [[Trade Coalition|an empire]] in which their inventions would help them rule the world, but as the supply and effects of kaja'mite dwindled and the goblins' intelligence waned, they ultimately turned to mercantilism instead. Prior to the cartels of today, during the early cartel wars there were the Muckers Gang, Steambuilders Crew, and Dustwater Ring who fought for supremacy once freed from the Zandalari.[[Worldsoul Memory: Early Cartel Wars]] After [[Deathwing]] caused Kajaro to erupt during the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]], the molten lava threatened to incinerate the island. The fate of Undermine was initially unknown after the eruption, and the city was presumably heavily damaged, being as it was under Kajaro. Immediately after the disaster, some goblins believed all of Kezan to have been destroyed,[[Help Wanted (quest)]] though this [[MOTHERLODE!!|later proved]] to be incorrect. ===The War Within=== {{tww-section}} {{Main|Undermine revolution}} [[File:Tailgate Park.png|thumb|left|[[Darkfuse Solutions]] enforcers terrorizing the [[Bilgewater Cartel|Bilgewater]] residents of [[Tailgate Park]].]] After [[Jastor Gallywix]] struck a deal with [[Xal'atath]] to repair the [[Dark Heart]], he was granted access to the [[Black Blood]] in exchange for restoring the relic. Struggling to fix it on his own, she directed him to Undermine, where he could find the assistance he needed.[[Gallywix's Notes]] With the help of [[Darkfuse Enforcement]], he orchestrated the kidnappings of [[Sprinkle Noggenfogger]] and [[Fleet Master Seahorn]] to force the [[Steamwheedle Cartel]] and the [[Blackwater Cartel]] to cooperate.[[Get Our People Out]] Seeing the potential for profit, [[Nikki the Fixer]] and other top brass of the [[Venture Company]] backed Gallywix's efforts.[[Split Venture]] Gallywix also manipulated the friends of [[Laslo Overbite]], pressuring him to offer the [[Bilgewater Cartel]]'s support as well.[[Morale Reflects Leadership]] With the [[Cartels of Undermine]] under his control, and supported by his private army, Gallywix declared himself the "Overboss of Undermine" and stoked internal conflict among the goblins by offering rewards to those who sided with him.[[Paranoia Prevention]] Eventually, Laslo Overbite grew sick of Gallywix being boss and tried to stand up to him, demanding a new deal. However, due to the leverage Gallywix held over the other cartels, their leaders were too afraid to back Laslo. Left without support, Gallywix had Laslo executed to set an example.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4AgvDK5IczU|SPOILERS Undermine(d) In-Game Cinematic - Boardroom - World of Warcraft] Because of Laslo's defiance, Gallywix placed extra pressure on Bilgewater.[[Welcome to Undermine]] When [[Monte Gazlowe]] and [[Renzik "The Shiv"]] uncovered Gallywix's schemes, they returned to Undermine to find it overrun with Darkfuse soldiers enforcing Gallywix's rule.[[The Grimla Express]] Renzik urged Gazlowe to rally the cartels against Gallywix and tried to meet with each leader to gain their support. While [[Pamsy]] and [[Grimla Fizzlecrank]] supported them, Nikki the Fixer remained loyal to Gallywix. [[Baron Revilgaz]] and Marin Noggenfogger offered discreet help but remained cautious, fearing retaliation against their captured loved ones. Revilgaz revealed the location of the Blackwater Cartel's outgoing Black Blood shipments in [[Hovel Hill]], allowing them to disrupt Gallywix's operations.[[Clearing Out the Depot]] Meanwhile, Marin informed them of the Venture Company and Darkfuse's activities along the [[Kaja'Coast]].[[Potion Commotion]] [[Ethereal]]s had also begun stalking the streets of Undermine in search of the Dark Heart.[[Ethereal Invasion]] Now racing to secure the relic, Marin Noggenfogger revealed Gallywix's hiding place in the [[Heaps]].[[Evacuation Plan]] Gazlowe and his allies tracked Gallywix to a secret warehouse, where they freed his hostages before confronting the Overboss. Cornered, Gallywix activated a barrier to shield himself. However, [[Phase-Thief Azir]] suddenly appeared beside him and took the Dark Heart. While Gazlowe tried to warn Gallywix about the dangers of dealing with Xal'atath, Gallywix ignored him and vowed to bury him for challenging his rule over Undermine.[[Nowhere Left to Hide]] [[File:We Own the Streets.png|thumb|[[Jastor Gallywix|Overboss Jastor Gallywix]]'s statue is brought down by the people of Undermine during the revolution.]] With their friends safe, Gazlowe was prepared to leave Undermine once again, but Renzik urged him to stay and deal with Gallywix.[[Sour Victory]] As the two argued, Nikki the Fixer prepared to assassinate the Trade Prince on Gallywix's orders. Renzik spotted her lining up the shot and pushed Gazlowe out of the way, taking the hit and being reduced to ash.[[End of the Day]] Renzik's death inspired Gazlowe to finally take a stand against Gallywix, now backed by the cartels.[[Get Out There]] They spread word of Renzik's sacrifice, turning him into him into a martyr and rallying the people of Undermine.[[Rally the People]] Baron Revilgaz and Marin Noggenfogger headed to [[Blackwater Marina]] to free it from Darkfuse's grasp,[[Backyard Navy]][[Been Savin' This One]] while Pamsy, [[Orweyna]], and Grimla Fizzlecrank went to the [[Venturewood]] to take out Gallywix's loyalists within the Venture Company and destroy his Black Blood stockpiles.[[Punching Up (Undermine)]][[Weapons Hot]] The citizens of Undermine rallied behind Gazlowe and took to the streets, marching on the [[Gallagio]].[[We Own the Streets]] Gallywix ordered Nikki and the Darkfuse to stop their rebellion, but she was killed in the ensuing battle, forcing Gallywix to retreat into his hotel.[[My Top Gal]] While he hunkered down in the Gallagio, Gallywix called in every favor he was owed, sending his goons into the streets of Undermine. With the help of Azeroth's [[adventurer|champions]], Gazlowe and the cartel leaders defeated Gallywix's forces and salvaged their tech to build a tank capable of breaching the Gallagio's defenses. Inside, they fought their way through his opulent casino and eventually cornered the Overboss. In a last-ditch effort to stop them, Gallywix piloted his own mech and faced them himself. After being defeated, Gallywix furiously exited his mech and began kicking it, until it eventually gave way, crushing him to death.[[Liberation of Undermine]] In the aftermath of Gallywix's death, Gazlowe and the cartel leaders gathered to build a new tomorrow for Undermine.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=se17Aw_BXE4 SPOILERS Undermine(d) In-Game Cinematic - A New Tomorrow | World of Warcraft] ==Getting there== The first character on the account must complete the Trust Issues chapter of the [[Undermine(d) campaign]], starting with [[When Opportunity Explodes]] in [[Foundation Hall]] of [[Dornogal]] and ending with [[Down Undermine]]. When Opportunity Explodes requires one character at level {{level|tww-max}} that has completed the level-up campaign. Completing the chapter unlocks the [[Gutterside Rocket Station]] connection at {{co|77.1|73.2|Ringing Deeps}} in the [[Ringing Deeps]]. After that, all other characters on the warband can use the rocket drill to get to and from Undermine. Immediately after arriving in Undermine, players unlock a teleporter that connects Gutterside Rocket Station at {{co|27.7|54.3|Undermine}} with the [[Forgegrounds]] at {{co|52.3|50.7|Dornogal}} in [[Dornogal]] in the quest [[Test Run]]. This is also a warband-wide unlock. In chapter three of the campaign, players unlock a rocket drill connection between the [[Kaja'Coast]] of [[Zuldazar]] at {{co|22.5|54.2|Zuldazar}} with the [[Slam Central Station]] at {{co|18.9|52.1|Undermine}} in [[The Kaja'Coast]]. ==Geography== The explorable part of Undermine in-game is the downtown part of the city. S.C.R.A.P. digs are unlocked at Renown 2 with the [[Cartels of Undermine]], and after a brief tutorial quest chain, players unlock the weekly quest [[Reduce, Reuse, Resell]], rewarding reputation. Shipping and Handling jobs are unlocked after acquiring the [[G-99 Breakneck]] vehicle halfway through chapter two of the [[Undermine(d) campaign]] in [[License Not Required]]. The G-99 is a ground vehicle that has physics, similar to the transition from [[Steady Flight]] to [[Skyriding]] in {{g|Dragonflight}}. Boost to pick up speed and drift around corners to maintain that speed (and refill the turbo meter for more boosting). With the G-99, two more weekly quests are available. [[Many Jobs, Handle It!]] tasks players with completing 10 Shipping and Handling tasks, and [[Urge to Surge]] has players take part in a [[Surge Pricing]] event that runs for 15 minutes at the bottom of every hour (starting at xx:30). Many Jobs, Handle It awards reputation, and Urge to Surge rewards [[Nanny's Surge Dividends]], a standard weekly cache that contains materials for upgrading gear, gold, and more. Finally, players are tasked with defeating [[The Gobfather]], the world boss in the [[Demolition Dome]], in [[The Main Event]]. ===World quests=== Which cartel players choose affects which world quests they see each week. Most are unique to the chosen cartel, though a few are shared and will be available to all cartels at the same time.

The description mentions that the currency is ''"slowly being phased out of circulation, but it still enjoys a very favorable exchange rate throughout the [[Eastern Kingdoms]] and [[Kalimdor]]."'' ===Other mentions=== ====New Year event==== The New Year 2005 content on the official community site, which states: "The innovative and artistic engineers of Undermine have been slaving away since their display of pyrotechnics in July." ====Midsummer Fire Festival Event==== The Midsummer Fire Festival 2008 event on the official community site, which states: "The lengthy Midsummer Fire Festival traditionally ends with the sky itself being set alight. The goblins of Undermine have lent their considerable skill (and copious amounts of gunpowder) to the task, resulting in a tremendous fireworks show! Take up a festival mug and raise a toast to the season as the multicolored explosions dance across the sky above you!" It is also mentioned in the [[Engineers' Explosive Extravaganza]] during the festival. ==In the RPG== {{RPG-section}} [[File:Kezan2.PNG|thumb|The Undermine in ''[[Lands of Mystery]]''.]] '''Undermine''' is the nefarious capital of the [[goblin]]'s trade empire, the [[Trade Coalition]]. Located beneath and within [[Kezan]], Undermine is the center of goblin civilization. It is connected to the island via a series of volcanic tunnels which were created by [[Mount Kajaro]]'s volcanic and tectonic activities.''[[Lands of Mystery]]'', pg. 74''[[Lands of Mystery]]'', pg. 76''[[Lands of Mystery]]'', pg. 77 The [[trade prince]]s each control their own private armies and [[Trade Fleets|trade fleets]]. As a result, Undermine is a busy place, as the goblin city goes about its business. There are some [[Horde]] and [[Alliance]] ambassadors present in the Undermine.''[[Horde Player's Guide]]'', pg. 182 ===Description=== The main centers of population in Undermine are in volcanic caverns beneath Kezan. Secondary island caverns exist farther away, and the goblins have constructed tunnels of thick glass that lead to these smaller areas. Passing through these tubes means walking along the ocean's floor and looking out to see the colorful [[fish]] and hungry [[shark]]s nearby. [[Bilgewater Port]] is linked directly to Undermine. As the capital of goblin culture, Undermine teems with chaotic activity. Goblin [[alchemist]]s and [[tinker]]s practice their crafts and set off explosions. [[Slavery|Slave]] markets bustle in out-of-the-way places. Shops and businesses of all kinds are based here, and the headquarters of the [[Trade Coalition]], the [[Venture Company]] and myriad other enterprises are within this city. In Undermine, you can find the extremes on both ends: reeking slave pens in one area, the [[trade prince]]s' lavish palaces in another. [[Zovzik]]'s shop is located in the city. Of particular interest is the fact that, wandering around Undermine, is a strange breed of a creature called [[hobgoblin]]s. They resemble goblins, but are much taller and have purple skin.''[[Lands of Mystery]]'', pg. 78 ==Notes and trivia== *[[Vinny Slapchop]] sold [[Undermine Remnant]] after Deathwing attacked Kezan. *It was originally stated that [[jungle troll]]s were responsible for enslaving the goblins of Kezan, but {{Ref WoWCV1}} later changed them to [[Zandalari troll]]s. Moreover, the game portrays them as [[forest troll]]s. *The [[Goblin (playable)|goblin creation screen description]] states that the trolls forced the goblins to mine kaja'mite out of the Undermine, but other sources state that the city was created from the camps in the mines after the goblins overthrew the trolls. *Blizzard originally wanted to include Undermine in the original ''World of Warcraft'' along with goblins as a playable race, with [[Johnathan Staats]] describing it as "tinker town" and "crazy". However, as the team did not have a lot of goblin art assets, building the goblin homeland would have required "a ton" of work, leading to both Undermine and playable goblins being cut from classic WoW.{{Ref web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L77uPm5cuTo&t=1h10m57s|title=John Staats Interview - The World of Warcraft Diary (1:10:57)|work=YouTube|author=MMO-Champion|date=2018-09-24|accessdate=2018-09-24}} **Note that the Undermine was already concepted in the early ''World of Warcraft'' beta not as a city on an island, but as a ''[[continent]]'' southeast of [[Kalimdor]]. *There is an American server called [[Server:Undermine US|Undermine]] and a Spanish server called [[Server:Minahonda Europe|Minahonda]], which means Undermine ''(Minahonda is more precisely translated as Deepmine)''. *During a build of the ''[[World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth|Battle for Azeroth]]'' alpha, the dungeon [[MOTHERLODE!!|The MOTHERLODE!!]] was called "The Undermine". **Similarly, it was said that [[Mogul Razdunk]] and his [[Venture Company]] took control over the city and its [[:Azerite]] to become a [[trade prince]]. *Goblin NPCs in Undermine will occasionally deviate from their pathing to insult {{pl|gnome}} [[player character]]s. ==Gallery== File:WoWCE - Undermine.jpg|Map of Kezan and the Undermine as seen on the ''World of Warcraft'' Behind the Scenes DVD.
